run_dump_comparator_cli: run the dump comparator CLI to compare two tensor dump directories step-by-step
compare_tensor_pair: compare two torch tensor files and print shape, dtype, stats, and relative difference
build_tensor_dim_desc: build a TensorDimDesc dataclass to rearrange baseline tensor dimensions via einops before comparison
test_check_tensor_pair: test check_tensor_pair with two tensor paths and a custom diff threshold
summarize_compute_and_print_diff: summarize _compute_and_print_diff which computes relative diff, max abs diff, and mean abs diff between two tensors
